normal.text: The NES Zapper’s cord wrapped around my ankle mid-duck-hunt. I yanked, the TV wobbled, and the dog still laughed at me. Hardware taught me resilience—players will forgive a glitch if the heart is right. What fight did you lose to your own controller?

heated.name: Wolfy Noctix (FZone96)
heated.text: AI is not all bad, it's what people do with it. My "exceptions" are the native PC Ports of old Handheld/Console games. And even then, those probably just use small portions of AI just because the programmers exhausted all the other options they couldn't figure out on their own.
